title: Crane as the Navy's off-world reverse-engineering center
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane; Wright-Patterson AFB

tellings.quote: my contacts told me that if rright Patterson is the center of the Air Force's most exotic off-world reverse engineer engineering efforts Naval surface Warfare crane is the center of the Navy's off-world reverse engineering efforts

plain: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research base, is said to be the center of the Navy's efforts to take apart and copy technology from beyond Earth, just as Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base, is said to be for the Air Force. Michels tells this himself, passing on what unnamed contacts told him. If true, each military branch would have its own hub for studying craft not made by humans.
